name: 5-day SMA of Price
code:
import pandas as pd

def calculate_5DaySMAOfPrice():
    df = pd.read_hdf("daily_pv.h5", key="data").sort_index()
    # rolling MUST be per instrument: a plain df[col].rolling(n) on the
    # (datetime, instrument) index mixes different stocks inside one window
    window = 5                              # put the factor's window here
    values = df["close"].groupby(level="instrument", sort=False).rolling(window).mean().droplevel(0)
    result = values.to_frame("5DaySMAOfPrice").reindex(df.index)   # keeps datetime+instrument index
    result.to_hdf("result.h5", key="data")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    calculate_5DaySMAOfPrice()
